verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs clearly describe payment initiation (single, scheduled, periodic, recurring/VRP) via its Payments API using local rails like UK Faster Payments and European SEPA, giving some geographic grounding, but there is no comprehensive, explicit list of supported countries/markets or independent confirmation of live coverage claims. missing for 10: full country/geography list, independent verification of live markets, and any hands-on confirmation of payment success rates.
